title: PAGR: Proof-Carrying Algebraic-Geometric Retrieval: A Quiver-, Provenance-, and Sheaf-Theoretic Framework for Grounded LLM Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.06127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation is usually formulated as a statistical information-retrieval problem. Graph-based variants add relational structure, but the mathematical status of that structure is often left underspecified. Three distinct questions tend to be conflated: which statements are certified as knowledge, which latent representations are useful for retrieval, and which multi-hop compositions are semantically admissible.   We propose Proof-Carrying Algebraic-Geometric Retrieval (PAGR), a framework that separates these questions mathematically. Its symbolic layer is a many-sorted relational theory generated by a typed quiver, path equations, and positive Horn inclusions. A quiver representation assigns inner-product spaces to entity types and linear operators to relations. A cellular sheaf measures local-to-global consistency. translated_title: PAGR：携带证明的代数几何检索：一个基于箭图、溯源与层理论的接地大语言模型检索框架
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通常被表述为一个统计信息检索问题。基于图的变体虽然增加了关系结构，但这种结构的数学地位往往未得到明确界定。三个截然不同的问题常常被混为一谈：哪些陈述被认证为知识、哪些潜在表示对检索有用，以及哪些多跳组合在语义上是可容许的。我们提出了携带证明的代数几何检索（PAGR），这是一个在数学上区分这些问题的框架。其符号层是一个由类型化箭图、路径方程和正Horn包含所生成的多类（many-sorted）关系理论。箭图表示为实体类型分配内积空间，并为关系分配线性算子。胞腔层（cellular sheaf）用于度量局部到全局的一致性。半环溯源记录推导过程，并支持机器可验证的证书。
tldr: 提出PAGR框架，通过结合类型化箭图表示、胞腔层理论和半环溯源，在数学上区分了知识认证、检索表示与语义可容许的多跳组合这三个问题，为大语言模型的接地检索提供可机器验证的证明证书。
en_tdlr: PAGR mathematically separates knowledge certification, retrieval-useful representations, and semantically admissible multi-hop compositions by combining typed quiver representations, cellular sheaves for local-to-global consistency, and semiring provenance with machine-checkable certificates for grounded LLM retrieval.
